products.name: PRAXTERRA Sustainability Self-Assessment Tool (Excel)
products.card: Score your organisation against the 40 requirements of the PRAXTERRA standard, level by level, and see where you stand.
products.intro: Score your organisation against the PRAXTERRA sustainability management standard (PT-SMS-001) and see where you stand.
does: Scores all 40 requirements, level by level, from 0 (absent) to 3 (complete)
Checks each level's pass rules automatically, using the thresholds published in the standard
Shows topic scores, gaps and suggested next actions
Includes an evidence register and an action log
Prints a one-page Self-Assessment Result Report
includes: The PRAXTERRA standard, Version 1.0 (Edition 1), PDF, 55 pages
products.good_for: Small and medium organisations, construction and renovation companies, workshops, offices, agri-food and logistics businesses, and HSE or quality managers who want a practical system without paying for a heavy one.
products.upsell: Want the records and a 30-day plan too? The Starter Kit has the tool, the ten records and a getting-started guide.
alts: PRAXTERRA Self-Assessment Tool: cover of the standard and the results sheet of a fictional worked example
What's inside the Self-Assessment Tool download: workbook, standard, Level 1 checklist, README and licence

products.name: PRAXTERRA Records Pack (Templates T01–T10)
products.card: Ten ready-made records for scope, effects, actions, controls, waste, suppliers, people, incidents and review.
products.intro: Ten ready-made records that help you put the PRAXTERRA standard into practice.
does: T01 Direction and scope
T02 Effects, priorities and obligations
T03 Decisions, objectives and actions
T04 Workplace controls and readiness
T05 Materials and waste
T06 Performance information
T07 Suppliers and purchasing
T08 People and communication
T09 Incidents, concerns and correction
T10 Assessment and review
products.does_note: Each record has column guidance, drop-down lists and a fictional example of a completed entry.
includes: The PRAXTERRA standard, Version 1.0 (Edition 1), PDF, 55 pages
products.good_for: Organisations that already know where they stand and need simple, consistent records to keep the evidence in one place.
products.upsell: Need the scoring tool as well? The Starter Kit has both, and costs €9 less than buying them separately.
alts: PRAXTERRA Records Pack: the T04 workplace controls record, the Level 1 checklist and the standard
What's inside the Records Pack download: workbook, standard, Level 1 checklist, README and licence

products.name: PRAXTERRA Sustainability Management Starter Kit
products.card: The Self-Assessment Tool, the ten records and a 30-day Quick-Start guide in one download.
products.intro: The self-assessment tool, the ten records and a getting-started guide in one download, for small organisations setting up the PRAXTERRA standard and working towards a first Level 1 self-assessment.
does: Self-Assessment Tool (Excel): scoring, pass-rule checks, results and the Self-Assessment Result Report
Records Pack T01–T10 (Excel): ten records with guidance and examples
Quick-Start Guide "Your first 30 days" (PDF, 6 pages): a suggested week-by-week plan for getting started. How long your organisation needs depends on its size and starting point.
products.does_note: You save €9 against buying the tool and the records separately.
includes: The PRAXTERRA standard, Version 1.0 (Edition 1), PDF, 55 pages, and the Level 1 Quick-Start Checklist
products.good_for: Small organisations setting up the standard for the first time and working towards a Level 1 self-assessment.
products.upsell: Training your own people or presenting results to leadership? The Professional Toolkit adds training decks, a worked example and the Result Report Templates.
alts: PRAXTERRA Starter Kit: the standard, the 30-day Quick-Start guide and the results sheet of a fictional worked example
What's inside the Starter Kit download: two workbooks, Quick-Start guide, standard, checklist, README and licence

products.name: PRAXTERRA Sustainability Professional Toolkit
products.card: Everything in the Starter Kit, plus a worked example, two training decks and the Result Report Templates.
products.intro: For implementers and HSE managers: everything in the Starter Kit, plus material to train your own people and present results inside your organisation.
does: Everything in the Starter Kit: tool, records, 30-day guide, standard and checklist

Filled worked example: a fictional 14-person renovation contractor, with the tool and records completed. It reaches Level 1 under the standard's scoring but not yet Level 2, and the example shows why.
Implementer training deck: 32 slides (PDF), material for a one-day internal course
Management briefing deck: 13 slides (PDF), the case and the decisions leadership must take
Result Report Templates: an editable Word template for the Self-Assessment Result Report, with the required disclosure built in, and a designed specimen (PDF)
products.does_note: The Result Report Templates carry a fixed self-assessment disclosure that must not be removed.

Implementer training deck, 32 slides, and management briefing deck, 13 slides (PDF)
Result Report Templates: editable Word template and designed specimen (PDF)
The PRAXTERRA standard, Version 1.0 (Edition 1), PDF, 55 pages, and the Level 1 Quick-Start Checklist
products.good_for: Implementers, HSE and quality managers who will run PRAXTERRA inside their own organisation, train colleagues and report results to leadership.
alts: PRAXTERRA Professional Toolkit: implementer training deck, management briefing deck, 30-day guide and the Result Report specimen
